text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait and Malaysia sign an accord to prevent double taxation. Visiting Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad to leave for Bahrain on Monday.
- Gulf Arab chambers of commerce agree to set up an information network.
- Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah decorates Malaysian Prime Minister Mohamad with Kuwaiti medal.
- Cabinet to discuss at Monday meeting a request by parliament to issue a weekly publication.
- Greek trade mission due in Kuwait on Tuesday.
- British business group to visit Kuwait later in April.
- Finance Ministry studies request by Kuwait Airways Corp (KAC) to raise ticket prices by 35 percent to increase revenue, Kuwait Investment Authority (KIA) sources said.
- Kuwait to deport Hepatitis B and C patients. The cabinet has placed hepatitis on the list of contagious diseases.
- MP proposes that business visas be granted within 24 hours to maintain Kuwait's status as a pioneer in commercial activity.
